name: Vitrina
tagline: WhatsApp-native website generator for local Mexican businesses
description: A platform that turns a WhatsApp conversation into a live, single-file website for a local business — pulling in their Instagram and Google Maps, generating a free 24-hour demo, and billing subscriptions through Stripe.
highlights: Hand-written zero-`node_modules` Node API — SMTP client, template engine, and auth all built from scratch for full auditability
Layered research pipeline (safe-fetch → Playwright) with per-demo USD budget caps on LLM spend
Cold-archive system that reactivates expired demos at $0 idle cost

name: MX Stock Analyzer
tagline: AI stock analysis for the Mexican market (BMV / SIC)
description: A bilingual SaaS that scores Mexican equities with a proprietary 6-signal technical model, layers Claude-generated narratives and backtests on top, and helps users build portfolios — with tiered billing in MXN.
highlights: Proprietary 6-signal 0–100 scoring engine over BMV/SIC market data
Two-level quota system (Redis L1 + Supabase L2) with quota-refund-on-failure
Built on a self-published open-source npm foundation (`@mx-market/*`)

name: AgentOS
tagline: An agent-agnostic operating system for shipping products with AI teams
description: An orchestration layer that runs 22 role-based AI agents across departments to take a product from a context pack to a deployed MVP, driven entirely by declarative Markdown / YAML workflow chains.
highlights: Declarative agent contracts + YAML workflow chains (product-launch, weekly-growth-loop)
Native multi-worker orchestration with git-worktree isolation
Enforced standard stack with security non-negotiables baked into PR gates

name: k6gen
tagline: Generate k6 load tests from an OpenAPI spec with LLMs
description: A packaged CLI that turns an OpenAPI spec into runnable k6 load tests — a deterministic core refined by a constrained LLM pass — shipped with a GitHub Action for CI.

name: k6 Observability Stack
description: A one-command load-testing observability stack: k6 wired into Prometheus and pre-provisioned Grafana dashboards so results are readable the moment a test runs.

name: LLM Inference Load Testing
tagline: Benchmark LLM endpoints under real workload models
description: A benchmarking suite for LLM inference — measuring TTFT, inter-token latency, and tokens-per-second against OpenAI-compatible and Ollama endpoints using open workload models.

name: mx-market-tools
tagline: Open-source tooling to analyze BMV stocks
description: A set of open-source TypeScript packages (`@mx-market/*`) for pulling and analyzing Mexican stock-market data — the reusable foundation underneath MX Stock Analyzer.

name: ChessLearn
tagline: Play chess vs friends or bots, with Stockfish post-game analysis
description: A chess app where you play against friends or bots and get a Stockfish-powered breakdown of your game afterward — blunders, best moves, and evaluation swings.

name: Weekly Radar Mix
tagline: Archive your Spotify Weekly Mix automatically
description: A Python automation that snapshots your Spotify "Weekly Mix" into a new dated playlist so the tracks never rotate out — running unattended on a GitHub Actions schedule.

name: Apodaca Accreditations
description: A multi-event accreditation system for Apodaca Group — a Flask backend serving three isolated portals (admin, companies, and check-in) with a QR scanner, in-app chat, and encrypted personal-record handling.

name: Atlas
tagline: A personal investing platform with a daily decision cycle
description: A local-first investing platform that runs a daily paper-trading loop against an IBKR account — strategy → risk gate → execute → journal — so every decision is logged and reviewable.

name: LibrosMX
description: A mobile-first marketplace where readers list, search, and swap books — with Google sign-in, real-time username search, and a genre-tagging system.

name: LearnHub
tagline: A freemium platform for video-based courses
description: A learning platform where creators publish lessons and quizzes and learners purchase, stream, and track progress — built on a 9-module NestJS domain with role-based access.

name: Gymzo
tagline: A MERN fitness tracker with progress analytics
description: A full-stack fitness app for logging workouts and routines, with an analytics engine that computes BMI, strength progression, and consistency scoring over a 55+ exercise library.

name: Evolith
description: A desktop game where you guide a species through survival, mutation, and predator encounters toward maximum intelligence — with stamina-based predator AI and RTS-style swarm commands.
